boundary: Read-only throwaway prototype archive; not imported by production. Actual component/native scope/draft functions, controlled visual port and synthetic backend only.
flowContract:
Goal: From an authorized client standing record, prepare an exact-client read in the existing PAIGE composer; the owner chooses whether to send it.
Human and feel: SOLO consultant/coach/fractional owner; informed and in control.
Entry and exit: Existing Clients standing CTA to existing Chat, with the original record and its source navigation retained.
System: Existing Obsidian/Mineral Clients and PAIGE surfaces; no new layout, sender, registry, approval or draft store.
Signature: Canonical selected-client context plus an editable, visibly unsent MERIT question.
Feedback: Existing panel/context announcement and composer; no added motion or haptics.
Rejecting: Automatic send; mixing a previous client's or business-only draft into another client's scope.
Variants: Empty/populated/current refresh, refused/loading/error, current/retired actor-business-client, existing same-scope draft and another-scope draft.

| From | Trigger/guard | To | Recovery/exit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Current authorized empty/populated standing | Ask PAIGE; original read frame still current | Existing exact-client context and visible unsent question | Edit, retain, clear or fold the original composer; no send occurs |
| Same-client draft already present | Ask again | Keep all existing work and append/deduplicate through the existing merger | Owner decides what to send |
| Other-client/business draft present | Change client focus | Keep prior draft in its original canonical scope; put question only in the selected scope | Clearing focus restores the prior business draft |
| Loading/refused/error/no workspace | No authorized displayed record | No standing question handoff | Existing original reload/permission/Setup recovery |
| Retired actor/business/client frame | Old callback/gesture | No prompt or scope write | Return to current authorized record |
| Ready unsent question | Owner presses Send | Original Chat authorization, read capability and native receipt | Existing refusal/unavailable/unknown/reload behavior; separately verified |

Routing: E04 O12; original client.engagement_status / read_client_engagement_status / caller-JWT read_client_engagement_status and exact clients.id. Existing PAIGE Gateway/Harness/Trust/INT346 remain authoritative. Drafting is local UI, not a business action or Layer C job.
